changes_from_v2_3: lines: k0_rr, dspark_k7_rr and dspark_var_rr join: k0, dspark_k7 and dspark_var with round-robin prefill (Config.round_robin_prefill), each against k0_rr, plain decoding under the same scheduler. The baseline tree's lines leave: this protocol does not run them
round_robin: new. What is run, what is reported, and the token checks. Effect sizes, no verdict

gates: only equivalence stays, and none of v2.3's others is rerun. With the option off the engine is main's, which round_robin.identity checks token by token against job D's runs; with it on only the scheduler's admission differs, no forward and no sampler code
dev, hypotheses, report_only, stop_if and confirm leave: they were the variable-length lines' and their job is done; round_robin holds this protocol's
order, timing_noise and kv_budget: reworded for this protocol's six lines; timing_noise at C = 8 and 32

gpu.name: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition

main.rule: a clean clone of one commit; every line's --commit

order: all lines of one (C, seed) run back to back in one job; the i-th seed (0-based) starts with the (i mod 6)-th of k0, k0_rr, dspark_k7, dspark_k7_rr, dspark_var, dspark_var_rr and continues in that order
kv_budget: C * ceil((max_prompt_len + max_tokens + 7) / 256) target blocks for every line; a block draft's cache mirrors the target's blocks

warmup.requests: first C of the panel, cycled

decision.a_beats_b: all paired gains same sign and abs(median) > 2*N_t
decision.report: median (min-max), two decimals; range only if max-min > 0.05. The README's headline, total table and figures are the exception: only the median of the 3 seeds, marked as such; the ranges go in RESULTS
decision.revised: 2026-11-02: the README rule of report decided by the author; the verdicts are unchanged

invalid_if: decode step or round > 3 x median
lines of one (C, seed) split across jobs: one job is one directory, protocol and panel, each line at the commit of its own tree

verify_schedule.made_by: job A on a G4 runtime at 5bf4cbc: tools/profile_verify_cost.py, then tools/fit_confidence_sts.py; seed 17011's calibration run was invalid (a round 5.15 x its median). The first rerun ran on kernels compiled under TORCH_LOGS=recompiles, which changes the kernels and the outputs, so it is not job A's command and does not count; a clean rerun passed with byte-identical confidences; reviewed by the author before this protocol is frozen

cost_curve.round: one round's phase timings summed, propose through commit_copy, on CUDA events; every row verifies query_len positions through the variable-length path, the confidence copy included; fresh requests of context_len random tokens for every (batch, query_len)
cost_curve.revised: 2026-11-02 from v2.1's external.cost_curve, which timed the verify forward alone: the schedule weighs a whole round

calibration.record: every round, each row's 7 confidence logits and its accepted count; all 8 positions are verified, so 'the first i drafts all accepted' is observed for every i
calibration.method: STS: for i = 1..7 in turn, T_i on the grid minimizing the binary cross-entropy of the survival prod_{j<=i} sigmoid(z_j / T_j) against 'the first i drafts all accepted', T_1..T_{i-1} fixed
report_only: ECE over 10 equal-width bins, per position and pooled, raw and after STS
AUROC of the survival pooled over positions, raw and after STS

replay.rounds: the calibration runs' rounds of C rows
replay.rule: a row with n of its 7 drafts accepted accepts min(n, L - 1) when it verifies L positions; a round's time is the cost table's at its token count, the fixed-length round's at 8 per row
replay.source: 2 x N_t, N_t = 1.26% in the cluster's job 236550, kept until the G4's own is measured

round_robin.rule: after the first C requests of a closed loop are prefilled, a step admits at most one request, and a prefill step is followed by a round while requests are being decoded (Scheduler._prefill_limit)

metrics.itl: tools/itl_stats.py: every gap between two deliveries of a request inside the steady window, on the CUDA timeline; p50, p99 and the share of gaps that hold a prefill step
metrics.ttft: p50 and p99 over every request

round_robin.report: for each pair, C and seed, round-robin / default of each metric; the README and RESULTS give the median (min-max) over the 3 seeds, and the lines' milliseconds
round_robin.verdict: none: these are effect sizes, and the option stays off by default whatever they are
round_robin.expect: from D48 at 9a97b6f: ITL p99 ratio 1.00 at C = 8, 0.68-0.92 at C = 32 and 0.58-0.70 at C = 64; Q_steady ratio 0.98-1.00; TTFT p50 up to 1.7 times at C = 64

identity.equivalence: gates.equivalence, run first: the job stops before the matrix if it fails
identity.c1: dspark_k7_rr at C = 1, seed 17011, is token-identical to dspark_k7: with one request in flight the two schedulers admit alike. Run with the equivalence gate
identity.default_arm: k0, dspark_k7 and dspark_var are token-identical to job D's runs of the same name (release results-variable-length), checked after the job

round_robin.default_arm_numbers: the README keeps job D's numbers for k0, dspark_k7 and dspark_var; this job's runs of them are the ratios' denominators only
stop_if: an identity check fails: no numbers; find the cause
an invalid run: its whole (C, seed) rerun once, per invalid_if

equivalence.reference: repeat 1 of the cluster reproduction, job 236550
